changes.title: A clearer dashboard
changes.detail: Each branch is one row with aligned columns: how far behind its parent, which environments already have it, and your uncommitted changes. Environments stay on top, and the branch you're on gets its own spot.

changes.title: Quick actions on hover
changes.detail: Hover a branch to check it out in one click, open its options, or jump to it in the graph. Right-click anywhere on it for the options.

changes.title: Finished branches
changes.detail: When every commit already reached every environment, the row says so and offers to delete or hide it.

changes.title: New branch, step by step
changes.detail: Pick the kind (feature, fix…), the ticket and a few words: it pulls the base first so you start from the latest code.

changes.title: Squash with your AI agent
changes.detail: Pick the commits, optionally write the message (or let the agent propose one), choose a backup and whether to push, then copy a prompt. Also from right-clicking a commit or a branch in the graph.

changes.title: Open a PR with your AI agent
changes.detail: Choose where it goes and copy a ready-made prompt for your agent.

changes.title: Saved work you can see
changes.detail: Changes put aside when you switch branches show up in the graph as their own dashed row, with files and lines, and in the branch's changes column.

changes.title: Branch options in the graph
changes.detail: Click a branch label in the graph to check it out or squash its commits.

changes.title: Notifications
changes.detail: Get a system notification when someone pushes to your branch, its base gets new commits, or a branch starts conflicting.

changes.title: Update without waiting
changes.detail: When a new version is out while you're using the app, press Restart to update right away.

changes.title: Options that explain themselves
changes.detail: Hover a choice like Stash, Rebase or WIP commit to see a short real-life example of when to use it.

changes.title: Switching branches with uncommitted changes
changes.detail: A clear dialog shows where you are and where you're going, and what each choice does.

changes.title: Catching up with main, in plain words
changes.detail: Merge or rebase, explained for anyone, with what happens to your commits.

changes.title: Smoother everywhere
changes.detail: Menus and dialogs pop in, Dashboard and Graph slide sideways like the tabs, and cards glide when the list changes.

changes.title: Remembers "Only this branch"
changes.detail: Once you turn it off, opening a branch from the dashboard keeps showing the whole graph.

changes.title: Copy path and the repo menu
changes.detail: Copying a repo's path works again, now also from an icon next to the star.

changes.title: Search every commit
changes.detail: Press ⌘K and type a ticket like MOA-854: every commit that mentions it, in this repo or all of them, with the branches and environments it already reached. Click one to open it in the graph.

changes.title: Copy for AI
changes.detail: Right-click a commit: copy just the repo and hash for an agent with git, or everything (message, files and the full diff). Files and folders in the tree have it too, with the branch.

changes.title: Only this branch
changes.detail: One click and the graph shows just that branch's own commits, nothing else. "View in graph" from the dashboard opens it this way.

changes.title: The whole project in the file tree
changes.detail: Turn off "Show changes only" to browse every file, and open any of them to read it whole. Hover a file to copy its path, show it in Finder or open it in your editor.

changes.title: Commit details
changes.detail: Click a commit to see its title above the files; "see more…" shows the description, hash, author, dates and the branches that contain it. Hide what you don't need.

changes.title: Each repo remembers its view
changes.detail: Switch repos and come back: same view, same commit, same file, shown at once while it refreshes in the background.

changes.title: Diffs only when you ask
changes.detail: Selecting a commit opens just its files; the diff shows when you pick a file, and clicking it again hides it.

changes.title: Every commit in sight
changes.detail: No more collapsed groups of commits: the graph lists them all.

changes.title: Tidier sidebar and toolbar
changes.detail: Auto sync and Force pull now sit in the sidebar, Add repository at the top of the list, and the graph's filters in a slim bar.

changes.title: Smoother file tree
changes.detail: Big projects scroll without lag, and one button collapses every folder.

changes.title: Switches and menus
changes.detail: Switches slide all the way, and right-click menus look right.

changes.title: No more repeated permission prompts
changes.detail: macOS now remembers that Monti Git can read your repos in Documents, instead of asking again and again.

changes.title: Pin a branch from the dashboard
changes.detail: With nothing pinned yet, a quick button lets you pick one.

changes.title: Redesigned branch cards
changes.detail: How long since the last commit, what it was, merge ticks per environment and where it stands with origin, all at a glance. Click a card to open it in the graph.

changes.title: Auto sync
changes.detail: Branches catch up with origin on their own while you use the app. Turn it off from the top bar anytime.

changes.title: Fix it with your AI
changes.detail: When a branch can't update on its own, copy a ready-made prompt for your AI agent to resolve the conflicts.

changes.title: Quick filters
changes.detail: See at once what's shipped, what's waiting in qa, what isn't merged and what changed after merging.

changes.title: Clean up shipped branches
changes.detail: Branches already in production turn grey and offer to hide or delete them.

changes.title: Squash and rebase merges
changes.detail: Branches merged with squash or rebase on GitHub now show as merged.

changes.title: Snappier tooltips
changes.detail: Help shows up almost instantly, and every button tells you what it does.

changes.title: Pick your repositories
changes.detail: Add repos one by one, or a folder with several inside. Nothing is scanned on its own anymore, so it works on Windows too.

changes.title: Right-click a repo
changes.detail: Add it to Favorites, hide it, or remove it (or its whole folder) from the sidebar.

changes.title: Star your favorites
changes.detail: Right after adding several repos, pick the ones you use most: they stay at the top of the sidebar.

changes.title: Colorful actions
changes.detail: Every option in the branch menus has its own color, so you find it at a glance.

changes.title: Opens on the dashboard
changes.detail: The app always starts on the overview of your branches.

changes.title: Monti Git
changes.detail: The app has a proper name now.

changes.title: What's new
changes.detail: After every update, this screen shows what changed since the version you had.

changes.title: Smoother feel
changes.detail: Soft animations everywhere: cards ease in, views and diffs fade, buttons respond to hover and clicks.

changes.title: Bigger view switch
changes.detail: Dashboard and Graph buttons are larger and easier to hit.

changes.title: "My branches only"
changes.detail: The graph filter got a clearer name and moved to the top right.

changes.title: Commit from the graph
changes.detail: Check the files to stage, write a title and description (the last commit's message shows as a hint), then Commit or Commit & Push.

changes.title: File type icons
changes.detail: Every file shows the icon of its format, like in VS Code.

changes.title: Flat file list
changes.detail: Switch the file tree to one row per file, with its folder dimmed.

changes.title: Cleaner history
changes.detail: Plain commits take a single line, and their text picks up the color of their branch line.

changes.title: Colored branch badges
changes.detail: Each badge matches its line in the graph.

changes.title: No more flashing windows on Windows
changes.detail: Git runs quietly in the background instead of opening a console each time.

changes.title: Faster update notices
changes.detail: New versions are also checked when you come back to the window.

changes.title: Automatic updates
changes.detail: New versions install by themselves when you open the app.

changes.title: New app icon
changes.detail: A little branch that leaves main and merges back.
